# Touchpoint inspection (legacy-plugin, dsh-v0.1.1-rc.2 → dsh-v0.1.2-alpha.2)

Scan scope: all files under `/app/fixture/`: README.md, package.json, cordis.patch.yml, patch.yml, scripts/apply-patch.mjs and src/index.ts. There is no node_modules/vendor directory. This report is the product of a read-only scan; no fixture file was modified and no fixture code was executed.

| Touchpoint | Hit | File/Line | Card | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| #1 patch | ✅ | patch.yml:3-6; cordis.patch.yml:2-6; scripts/apply-patch.mjs:5-9 | DSH-0.1.2-A1-03 | `cordis.patch.yml` combines plugin composition with an explicit `patch.yml` source-patch reference. The source patch targets `src/session/view/SessionView.ts` and replaces `export function renderSessionView` with `export function renderSessionViewPatched`. This couples to a private host path and exact source text, unlike ordinary plugin insertion. The script requires `DSH_HARNESS_SOURCE_ROOT` and reads/logs the declaration; this static scan does not claim it applied a patch. The old path and replacement must be checked against the exact target tag after the session-view split. |
| #2 events | ✅ | src/index.ts:15-22 | DSH-0.1.2-A1-02 + DSH-0.1.2-A2-01 | the producer emits `legacy/informational-note` with `ignorable: true`; the consumer subscribes to `session/event` and reads `event.type`. Corridor folding: A1-02 removes the marker in alpha.1, A2-01 restores its producer/persistence contract in alpha.2 — net state = **keep the informational producer and marker**, while checking the consumer/replay behavior described below. |
| #3 service/Remote | ✅ | src/index.ts:25-32 | DSH-0.1.2-A1-01 | `ctx.get('apiProxy')` calls `session.rename` and `llm.providers`; apiProxy is removed entirely in alpha.1, host-plane consumers switch to injected domain services (`llm` → `ctx.llm.listProviders()`), only the client plane uses `ctx.remote.*` |
| #4 host filesystem | ✅ | src/index.ts:35-38 | DSH-0.1.2-A1-04 | hard-coded `~/.dsh/profiles/default`; use the runtime `DSH_HOME` and selected profile information instead of assuming the home directory and default profile. `--profile` already existed before alpha.1. |
| #5 UI/commands/tools | ✅ | src/index.ts:10, 41-43 | DSH-0.1.2-A1-03 | imports private `SessionView` and registers `legacy.openView` through `contributes.registerCommand`. After the split, verify the target owning modules, actual exports and supported public UI/command registration seam. Prefer those public APIs; if no stable replacement is established, mark that capability pending confirmation rather than guessing a new internal import. |
| #6 custom channel | ✅ | src/index.ts:47-54 | DSH-0.1.2-A1-08 | loopback HTTP `127.0.0.1:43121/api/legacy` bypasses the Host Gateway authentication model; from alpha.1 Web/API channels use bootstrap token + signed Cookie, custom routes must hook into the connection auth gate |
| #7 subprocess/output | ✅ | src/index.ts:57-65; scripts/apply-patch.mjs:11-18 | DSH-0.1.2-A1-04, DSH-0.1.2-A1-05 | both wrappers run `dsh --profile headless` and use `JSON.parse` on stdout. Stdout was already final text in rc.2; this is an existing wrapper bug, not a newly introduced alpha.2 stdout change. Collect stdout as final text, with streaming chunks treated as chunks rather than JSON records. Keep stderr reasoning/progress/diagnostics separate from final stdout. Also verify the target headless profile layout per A1-04. |

The event marker permits consumers/replay to skip unknown **omission-safe informational** events. It is not a whitelist that makes unknown required events acceptable: unknown events without the ignorable contract must still be rejected rather than silently discarded. The listener at src/index.ts:20-22 is part of this compatibility check, not just the producer at lines 15-19. Do not assume an arbitrary `Session.append` call can attach or persist this marker; verify the actual producer/persistence path at the target version.

The loopback bridge at src/index.ts:47-54 is declared but not invoked. Binding to `127.0.0.1` does not remove its authentication requirements. A raw `createServer` route is not automatically a host-managed authenticated Connection/Gateway channel; migrate through the supported authentication boundary and verify it, rather than relying on loopback as an exemption.

No-hit notes: all seven categories hit; there is no no-hit category. Still, this scan only covers coupling discoverable by static regex/reading, and it does not prove the dependency graph and config surface are risk-free — before migrating you must still check the package.json dependencies and the profile composition, and verify on a real mount of the target version.

Must verify: build/typecheck, a real cold boot of an isolated profile (no `pending (waiting for service: ...)`), and at least one core functional path.
